location (city).finding: 0 options on click with no typing; real results only after typing a query (e.g. typing 'Austin' returned 'Austin, Texas, United States' etc). This is a genuine live-search field with no fixed list, not a capture miss -- unlike School/Degree/Discipline, which DO return a real default list on click alone.
location (city).implication: Cannot be shape-checked against a fixed option list. Fill/suggest logic for this field needs to type-and-match rather than pick-from-list.

country.finding: id=country, react-select-country-placeholder -- this IS the phone number's country-CODE selector (options are 'United States +1', 'Afghanistan +93', ...), not a country-of-residence field. 'Land' is the same field, Dutch-localized, on Flexport.
country.implication: A field labeled 'Country' on Greenhouse is NOT reliably a residence-country field -- must disambiguate by id/widget id, not by label alone, or risk filling a phone code into a residence answer or vice versa.

are you subject to any employment agreem.finding: Spot-checked live: options are genuinely exactly ['Yes','No']. Confirms the 59 generic-only-option questions in this corpus are very likely correct data (real binary questions), not an under-capture artifact -- but only this ONE of the 59 was individually verified against a live page.
